title: EcoTrack cloud complete ER model
description: Solid relationships are declared FKs. Dashed relationships are logical associations. External entities are selected reference projections, not complete provider schemas. Cardinalities follow nullable references and unconditioned key uniqueness; partial uniqueness is documented in the dictionary.

diagrams.title: EcoTrack cloud schema
